info.name: Data Interchain Messaging API
info.description: The Data API provides web3 application developers with multi-chain data related to Avalanche's primary network, Avalanche subnets, and Ethereum.

variable.description: (Required) The teleporter message ID of the ICM message.

request.description: Gets an ICM message by teleporter message ID.

response.name: Successful response

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

query.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.
The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 100.
The base58 encoded blockchain ID or evm chain ID of the source chain that the ICM message was sent from.
The base58 encoded blockchain ID or evm chain ID of the destination chain that the ICM message was sent to.
The base58 encoded blockchain ID of either source or destination chain that one ICM message interacts with.
The address of the recipient of the ICM message.
The address of the sender of the ICM message.
Either mainnet or testnet/fuji.
